text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operate a transit service on Warren Crescent, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the alternate-side parking regulation on Warren Crescent, between Varsity Road and Crosby Avenue, and provide parking on the east and south sides of the street at all times. The proposed parking amendment will increase on-street parking availability for permit holders, it will not impact traffic operations, but it may have a negative impact on mechanical street cleaning.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect from December 1 of one year to March 31 of the next following year, inclusive, on the east side of Warren Crescent, between Crosby Avenue and Lundy Avenue. 2. City Council rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect from the 16th day to the last day of each month from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the east and south sides of Warren Crescent, between Crosby Avenue and a point 29 metres west of Varsity Road. 3. City Council rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect from the 1st day of each month to the 15th day of each month from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the west and north sides of Warren Crescent between Crosby Avenue and Varsity road. 4.
